title: Live changes over AppSync's realtime protocol
description:
As a web app using `observeQuery` and `onCreate`, I want the local server to speak AppSync's realtime WebSocket protocol.

```gherkin
Feature: Realtime subscriptions
  Scenario: A subscriber hears a create
    Given a WebSocket client subscribed to onCreatePost
    When another client creates a Post titled "Hi"
    Then the subscriber receives a "data" message whose title is "Hi"
```
